frase_inicial: Michael: your score is 26 and three clear choices shape what your money can do next.

tarjetas.frente: January 2027 house and vacation are asking for the same cash
tarjetas.reverso: If you keep the purchase and the trip as planned, the cash you have today wouldn’t cover them. That would force you to pull from investments or stop saving for retirement—both change how long your money lasts.
tarjetas.detalle: Home down payment to hold in Jan 2027: $113,300 (Michael). Vacation next payment: $3,500 in Jan 2027.

tarjetas.frente: Retirement savings won’t last to the plan’s end
tarjetas.reverso: At your target retirement age, savings are projected to run out before the plan ends, leaving planned spending unpaid. That means future income depends heavily on the balance you keep building now.
tarjetas.detalle: Savings and investments run out at age 85; planned unpaid spending then: $32,439 (today's dollars).

tarjetas.frente: Your cash cushion is thinner than it should be
tarjetas.reverso: Right now your bank and accessible cash cover only a few months of expenses. That makes any pay cut, surprise bill or big purchase risky unless you separate and protect the home money.
tarjetas.detalle: Accessible cash today: $30,000; recommended emergency reserve (5–6 months): $46,530–$55,836.

tarjetas.frente: Protection gaps could expose your income and savings
tarjetas.reverso: Life cover and a liability shield are both well below recommended levels. If something happened to your earning ability or a liability claim arose, your liquid savings would absorb much of the hit.
tarjetas.detalle: Life insurance: $180,000 vs recommended $900,000–$1,800,000. No umbrella policy; recommended minimum $1,000,000.

tarjetas.frente: A small win: debt is manageable but one card costs a lot
tarjetas.reverso: Total debts are not large versus your income, so they aren’t the main problem. Still, the high-rate card is the most expensive and paying it down faster gives a guaranteed saving if cash allows.
tarjetas.detalle: Credit card balance $3,500 at 20% APR; current monthly payment $200 (Michael).

movimientos.title: Add umbrella cover
movimientos.action: Add $1M of umbrella to raise the liability shield

movimientos.title: Lower the withdrawal rate
movimientos.action: Cutting withdrawals to $10,300/year (6.0%) reaches the sustainable band

movimientos.title: Raise growth allocation toward glide
movimientos.action: Move the invested mix from 74% to 88% growth (glide 98%) for the next horizon-fit band — about $19,900 of the invested book

mapa.aviso: Illustrative simulator: it shows the direction of change, not a Sherpas projection.

siguiente_paso.razon: It fills a clear protection gap identified in the plan and raises your liability shield, protecting the liquid savings you’re building for the home and retirement.
pasos: Collect your auto and renter insurance declarations pages and policy numbers
Call or email one insurer or broker and ask for a one‑million liability quote that adds an umbrella over your existing policies
Compare the quoted premium to your monthly budget and pause any purchase if the premium doesn’t fit
